source: LROC NAC south polar controlled average mosaic, 1 m/px (Credit: NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University)
frame: local east/north (m) of grid, node (i,j) at ((i-15)*100, (j-15)*100); affine fit max error 0.05 m
dark_rule: pixel dark if DN < 13.2 (= max(2, 0.08 x p95 of valid DN)); node observable if >= 90 % of its 100 m cell is valid and not dark AND never_lit_18y == 0
